cleansing face mask

95% ingredients of natural origin

Suitable for oily, combination & acne-prone skin. Helps to reduce excessive sebum secretion. Makes dilated pores less visible. Soothes skin irritataions. Normalises sebaceous glands activity. Actively moisturises and regenerates.

How to use

Apply a thick layer of mask over face and neck 2-3 times a week. Avoid the eye area. Rinse off after 10-15 minutes.

INCI

Aqua (Water), Canola Oil, Cetearyl Ethylhexanoate, Kaolin, Octyldodecanol, Glyceryl Stearate, PEG-100 Stearate, Cetyl Alcohol, Propylene Glycol, Hydrogenated Coco-Glycerides, Polyacrylamide, C13-14 Isoalkane, Laureth-7, CI 77891 (Titanium Dioxide), Dimethicone, Saccharomyces/Zinc Ferment, Butylene Glycol, Panthenol, Allantoin, Xanthan Gum, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium Benzoate, Parfum (Fragrance), Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone.
 
The list of ingredients is consistent with the current state of manufacture as of 2023-04.

MAIN INGREDIENTS

allantoin, provitamin B5 (D-panthenol), zinc-protein complex, grey clay
